title: Local Phase IV, Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) Sleep Study US
brief_summary: The purpose of this research study is to compare the safety and effectiveness (how well the medicine works) of esomeprazole (study drug) to placebo (a capsule that does not contain any medication) taken daily in relieving nighttime heartburn and problems sleeping in patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD).
